# hourslip

> hourslip is a Claude Code mod that keeps a timesheet per client and ticket while you work. It attributes time to a client by the folder you are in and to a ticket by the git branch, shows today's time in the status line, and exports CSV files and a printable report. Pro publishes a report link your client can open and confirm.

## What it records

- When prompts and turns start and end, the working folder and the git branch. Never prompt text, never file contents. Data stays in ~/.hourslip until the user presses Publish.
- Hours are a lower bound: only time in Claude Code with the mod loaded, plus time the user adds by hand, which the report labels.

## Confirm

- A client can type a name and confirm a published report. hourslip does not verify who confirms: anyone with the link can.

## Install

    claude plugin marketplace add ChuKhaLi/hourslip
    claude plugin install hourslip@hourslip

If the first line fails to clone the repository (git may try SSH), give the full URL instead:

    claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/ChuKhaLi/hourslip.git
